question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

__Exclusion__ of someone from a common group harms the human society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Prohibition**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"exclusion"** means the act of preventing someone from participating in an activity or from being a part of a group. (बहिष्कार)

 
 
• **Example: **The exclusion of women from the club caused a lot of controversies.
 
 
 
• **"Prohibition"** refers to the act of officially not allowing something to be done. (निषेध)
 
 
• **Example: **The prohibition of smoking in public places has improved air quality.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Prohibition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Submission **(आत्मसमर्पण): The action of accepting or yielding to a superior force or to the will or authority of another person.

 
 
• **Example:** His submission to the company's rules earned him a promotion.
 
 
 
• **Admission **(प्रवेश): The process or fact of entering or being allowed to enter a place or organization.
 
 
• **Example: **Her admission to the university was a moment of great joy for her family.
 
 
 
• **Inclination** (रुझान): A person's natural tendency or urge to act or feel in a particular way.
 
 
• **Example:** He has an inclination towards helping those in need.
